title: Masonry
description: Walls, buildings and stone towers recorded by their faces: elevations on planes, cylinders and tower sides; lean, bulge, sections and tower axis measured on the model; stones, courses and mortar with the type the measures suggest; USM relationships proposed for you to check; plates at scale, DXF, IFC wall, PyArchInit

it.title: Murature
it.description: Muri, edifici e torri in pietra rilevati per facce: prospetti su piani, cilindri e lati di torri; strapiombo, spanciamento, sezioni e asse delle torri misurati sul modello; pietre, filari e malta con il tipo che le misure suggeriscono; rapporti fra USM proposti da verificare; tavole in scala, DXF, IFC del muro, PyArchInit
